policies.dependency_over_book_order: A later source chapter may be mined early for one shared prerequisite when another textbook needs it. This never marks that later chapter complete.
policies.exact_match: One source-neutral canonical Lean declaration, then source-facing wrappers if needed.

groups.boundary: This identifies the induced length distance of a positive-dimensional unit sphere. It leaves the ambient chord metric unchanged; for antipodal points these two distances are \(2\) and \(\pi\). The condition \(n>0\) is essential for arbitrary endpoint pairs: the two-point sphere has no continuous internal path between its two distinct points. It supplies no global Riemannian bundle instance, general manifold geodesic-existence theorem, transport estimate, stochastic result, or textbook chapter completion. Spherical transport is a possible consumer of the distance identity.
